parsed.rationale: The second participating record resides at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a canonical sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app: false` flag on the record. The first record is a production method `DebugMetricsProvider.measureCPUUsage` in the `DebugPanel` package. Consolidating these two would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to a sample-app demonstration context, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. The duplication is intentional: the sample app re-implements CPU measurement locally to remain self-contained.
